data.name: Nisarg
data.gender_notes: Nisarg is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word निसर्ग (nisarga), meaning 'not created'. In Hindu mythology, Nisarg is the embodiment of nature and the essence of all things. It is also the name of a sage and a planet in Hindu astrology. The name Nisarg carries the meaning “Natural, Essence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nisarg usually hope their child will grow to embody natural, essence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Connected to the natural world and the divine.
data.etymology: Nisarg belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Natural, Essence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nisarg total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_sanskrit.name: निसर्ग
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अन्ततः (anatas) – beyond, uttara-adhik (uttar-adhik) – more towards, vijñāna (vijñana) – knowledge. The name Nisarg can be interpreted as ‘that which is beyond knowledge’, or ‘that which is more towards knowledge’, or simply ‘the source of knowledge’.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nisarg holds a deep cultural significance in Hinduism, particularly in the realm of nature and spirituality. It is derived from the Sanskrit word, which emphasizes the uncreated and organic nature of the universe. The name resonates with the idea of self-existent truth, a constant reminder of the eternal and everlasting aspects of nature. In Hindu art, literature, and folklore, Nisarg is often depicted as a symbol of the unchanging and eternal aspects of nature.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Nisarg represents the ultimate truth, the unsullied and unchanging essence of the universe. It is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the impermanence of material existence. The name carries a deep sense of inner peace and tranquility, as it is often associated with the idea of a perfect harmony between the individual soul and the universe. Nisarg is a name that invites introspection, encouraging one to connect with the deepest aspects of themselves and the natural world around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nisarg represents the inherent truth or essential nature within us, guiding us towards self-realization and enlightenment. It is the pure consciousness that transcends the limitations of the physical world.
